notes.description: The query groups sales by the exact timestamp (including hours, minutes, and seconds), which is far too granular. Combined with LIMIT 100, this restricts the visualization to only a few hours of the first day (2010-12-01), failing to show a meaningful chronological trend over the dataset's duration.
notes.fix_instruction: Aggregate the data by day using the first 10 characters (YYYY-MM-DD) of the InvoiceDate column, group by this daily value, and order chronologically.
notes.fixed_sql_query: SELECT substr(InvoiceDate, 1, 10) AS InvoiceDate, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS sales_amount FROM data GROUP BY substr(InvoiceDate, 1, 10) ORDER BY InvoiceDate ASC
